description: The transcript of one YouTube video, Short or livestream as clean text, with title, channel, language and optional timestamped segments. Videos without captions are refused free. Costs $0.01 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

languages.description: Comma-separated caption languages in order of preference (default en)

timestamps.description: Include every caption line with start time (default false)
